title: backlog check warns of sprint items that share a file with no depends_on order between them
goal: Retro SP-ytfb4dc5: ST-f4ra5s7y shared kb/_self/backlog.md and tools.md with two earlier stories and its notes said 'runs last' but it had no depends_on, so the orchestrator ordered it by hand at run time. backlog.py check warns (exit 0) of two open items of one planned or active sprint whose touches overlap (globs read against tracked files) while neither depends on the other (directly or through ancestors), naming both and the shared paths, so the plan orders them before start. Planted tests: an overlapping unordered pair warns, an ordered pair and a disjoint pair do not.
